build_image_segmentation_parameters: build ImageSegmentationParameters with mask_threshold, overlap_mask_area_threshold, subtask, and threshold for inference
create_image_segmentation_input: create ImageSegmentationInput with base64-encoded image data and optional segmentation parameters
parse_image_segmentation_output_element: parse ImageSegmentationOutputElement containing label, base64-encoded mask, and confidence score
filter_image_segmentation_subtask: filter ImageSegmentationSubtask to select instance, panoptic, or semantic segmentation mode
summarize_image_segmentation_output: summarize ImageSegmentationOutputElement outputs with label, mask, and score fields
